expected.representationReview: Peter Lockwood resigned from Baird Ward effective 29 October 2026. The single-councillor ward is vacant. Knox Council now confirms a postal by-election: voting closes at 6 pm AEDT on 5 February 2027, with by-election day 6 February. The roll closes at 4 pm AEDT on 25 November 2026; nominations open 14 December and close at noon AEDT on 22 December. Other retained roles keep their earlier verification dates. Checked 8 November 2026.
